authorization: User authorizes exactly two Squeeze architectures on entire available 2023 history; Draft PR; no merge or next strategy.

rules.atr: Wilder ATR20, seed average first 20 TR; first candle TR=High-Low; subsequent TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)); then (19*previousATR+TR)/20. Current completed candle included.
rules.cost: C1=dated tick at entry+dated tick at exit. C2 replaces with2*C1 on identical admitted trades, protection and exits; never recompute Take or filter. Unknown total cost/Net/R null; known entry cost separate.
rules.ema: EMA20 seeded by SMA of first 20 consecutive completed closes, alpha=2/21; current candle included.
rules.end: First completed squeeze=false ends the episode, freezes its High/Low and arms it if >=3. A close outside the frozen range on this or a later off candle confirms directional expansion. No extra indicator threshold.
rules.entry: MSK UTC+3 start label. Signal ready=start+T10/T15; target=first M5 slot strictly later. Pending reserves run. Exact target Open only, no entry retry. Open must be strictly beyond edge, at/better than cap=edge+direction*0.5*signalATR rounded inward; positive Volume, risk>=4 dated ticks, grid valid. Scheduled full candle must end<=B-30. No lookahead existence/price filter at signal.
rules.failed_breakout: Delivered completed Close within inclusive original [Low,High] and candle start>=entry start: request market exit at strictly future Open. Beyond opposite edge alone does not satisfy inside; resident stop remains active.
rules.metrics: Per instrument normalized quote units only; no portfolio RUB sum. All12 months; pre-inception NO_COVERAGE, launch month PARTIAL_LAUNCH. Missing expected slots imply PARTIAL_DATA. Full annual Net/PF/DD null if any incomplete coverage or UNKNOWN. Closed-only diagnostic always labelled. Monthly complete Net/PF only when covered and no UNKNOWN; signs of closed subsets separately. MFE uses no favorable exit-bar extremes on Stop/market exits; UNKNOWN MFE lower bound only; early potential winner defined previously observed >=1R and exited before Take.
rules.missing: No target candle -> NO_BAR_NO_MODEL_FILL; no price/cost/position. Missing path with exposure -> UNKNOWN (never Stop/profit/zero). Emergency reduce-all requested at observation clock and retries allowed Open until conditional flat acknowledgement; past payoff stays null. Boundary breach remains liability/UNKNOWN; no automatic overnight assumed flat.
rules.mtf: DERIVED_EXACT_COMPLETED_M5_V1: latest expected two adjacent clock-aligned M30 cells within same window. Each exactly six existing positive-volume completed delivered M5 children. Missing/late child rejects; no stale fallback. Sustained +1 if both C>O and second C>first C; -1 symmetric; otherwise0. Reject only sustained adverse direction; unknown context rejects.
rules.protection: Resident precommitted conditional stop from entry; stop touch, adverse gap worse Open; Stop-first; no TP on entry bar; later TP requires penetration one dated tick; no favourable gap credit.
rules.rearm: First directional close consumes cycle regardless of busy/filter/nonfill. Next true candle starts a fresh episode and expires unused old range. Gap/window ends unused range. Equality to boundary or close inside gives no signal; wait only while squeeze remains false.
rules.reset: At window/day boundary, missing delivered M5 or nonpositive Volume: indicators, squeeze episode and armed range reset; no data bridging.
rules.squeeze: Strict upperBB<upperKC and lowerBB>lowerKC; >=3 contiguous true completed candles confirms. Range includes all true candles in episode including first two, never off/breakout candle.
rules.std: Population: sqrt(sum((Close-SMA20)^2)/20), current completed signal candle included; Decimal precision 34. No ddof fitting.
rules.stop: edge-direction*0.25*signalATR, rounded LONG up/SHORT down as accepted Stage1 contract. Freeze before Open. Never adjust stop to manufacture R.
rules.take: At actual model Open: risk=direction*(Open-stop); predictedC1=2*entry dated tick (same research window cannot cross CNY switch); Take=Open+direction*(3*risk+predictedC1), LONG ceil/SHORT floor tick. Net planned reward/risk>=3. Gross target distance<=3*signalATR; otherwise NONFILL. Same rule is checked at signal Close, then Open, not optimized. Venue price limits/GO remain unverified; normalized exposure model only.
rules.timers: Session request latest M5 clock with nextOpen+scenarioDelay<=B-10 (T10 B-25, T15 B-30). MAX_HOLD request at entryStart+115 -> next Open at entryStart+120; acknowledgement later. Session has priority; earliest already scheduled exit is retained. No BE/trailing.
